description: This file implements a device driver for the ITE IT8XXX2 PECI hardware interface in the Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, initialization, transfer, and interrupt handling functions.

methods.name: peci_it8xxx2_init
methods.description: Initializes the PECI driver, configures pins, sets default bitrate, and assigns interrupt.

methods.name: peci_it8xxx2_configure
methods.description: Configures the PECI interface with specified bitrate.

methods.name: peci_it8xxx2_transfer
methods.description: Performs a PECI message transfer, handling data transmission and reception.

methods.name: peci_it8xxx2_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for PECI transfer completion.
